quote: I've hired Seth at two different companies. I first brought him on as an individual contributor, then quickly promoted him to Design Manager and later Director. His unique skillset combines exceptional visual craft across complex product experiences and bold brand design with deep technical expertise and the ability to stay ahead of the curve with emerging technologies, including AI. He's a leader who unites teams around a vision, develops exceptional talent, and leads with genuine empathy. I would trust him to build and lead a design organization without hesitation.
author: Ingrid Cruz

quote: Seth and I have worked together extensively in various capacities, from collaborators to business partners. Seth is a genuinely good, caring, compassionate person. He leads with curiosity and asks questions that cut through the clutter. He has zero ego. Instead, he cares about people, making meaning, and the means to solve problems. This is why he has a voracious appetite and natural excitement around technology and tools and thinks like an entrepreneur anywhere he goes. He ideates like a visionary, because he is one. Seth is a delight to create with and will make you a better person by association alone.
author: Brian Collier
